lessons.title: Things in the classroom
objectives: Name a book, pen, desk, chair, board, and bag with a or an.
Use classroom objects in one short, clear everyday exchange.

content_sections.title: Language focus
content_sections.body: In lesson 6: classroom objects, notice this model: There is a blue book on Mai's desk. Keep the word order short and make the meaning clear.

content_sections.title: Everyday context
content_sections.body: Read the original mini-context for lesson 6: classroom objects: 'There is a blue book on Mai's desk.' Say which words carry the main information.

exercises.prompt: Complete the key detail for lesson 6: classroom objects: There is ___ on Mai's desk.
Put the three learning steps for lesson 6: classroom objects in a useful order.

Notice the form in Things in the classroom
correct_order: Notice the form in Things in the classroom
Create a new classroom objects example

criteria: The response clearly addresses classroom objects in lesson 6.

listening.instruction: Listen to the tutor read the lesson 6: classroom objects transcript once. Answer one question before seeing the text.
listening.goal: Identify one explicit detail about classroom objects.
listening.transcript: There is a blue book on Mai's desk.
listening.question: What is on Mai's desk?
constraints: Do not reveal the transcript before the learner answers.
Ask exactly one comprehension question.
Use only the supplied project-authored transcript.

speaking.instruction: Take the learner role in a two-turn exchange about classroom objects in lesson 6; respond with one or two short sentences.
speaking.goal: Use the classroom objects language focus intelligibly.
constraints: Use at most two tutor turns.
Correct only one blocking error after the response.

pronunciation.instruction: Read the target words for lesson 6: classroom objects aloud, then compare clear final sounds and stress.
pronunciation.goal: Produce the selected classroom objects words clearly.
constraints: Assess pronunciation only when learner audio is available.
Return NOT_ASSESSED when no audio is supplied.

writing.instruction: Write two sentences about classroom objects. For lesson 6: classroom objects, submit your draft before receiving two brief improvement points.
writing.goal: Write a short A1 response about classroom objects.
constraints: Wait for the learner draft before giving feedback.
Do not replace the learner draft with a complete rewritten answer.
